what_failed.where: stage P, materializing the sixth arm (incumbent B)
what_failed.error: SafetensorError: Error while serializing: I/O error: No space left on device (os error 28), at `Writing model shards`
what_failed.not_a_provenance_finding: B's compute COMPLETED — depth.causal_kl_greedy_v1 ran all seven greedy rounds in 32.8 min and chose its layers. The failure is the final write. No digest mismatched; this is an ordinary engineering failure.
what_failed.root_cause: `materialize_fixed_path` writes every step of a four-step path into the arm's workdir and returns them all, and nothing deleted the intermediates. All six arms' full paths therefore stayed resident for the whole of stage P. The storage derivation charged `b_materialization_transient` exactly ONCE, in as many words: 'resident while that arm builds and released when it is verified'. Nothing released them, so the bound described a program that did not exist. A resource bound has to follow the real free() call sites.
what_failed.why_the_120_gb_provision_is_still_correc: with the repair, peak residency is the image and environment (~30 GiB), the teacher (7.51), five finished 1.11 GiB arms and ONE arm's transient (16.12) — about 59 GiB against 111.8 GiB available. The provision does not need to change; the code does.

scientific_evidence_preserved._what_this_establishes: all five frozen Top-5 candidates rebuilt to their exact recorded artifact digests on fresh hardware, independently of the replay that first reconstructed them. Every one was identity-gated before being announced. This is a real second reproduction and it survives the failure. `1d284448` is worth naming: it failed at step 0 in replay attempt 8 and only reproduced once the evidence-bound root pin was derived — it rebuilt exactly here too, so the pin holds on new hardware.
scientific_evidence_preserved._nothing_was_lost: no probe finished, so nothing was owed off-pod and nothing expensive was discarded. required_products_secured recorded ok with 'the driver finished no probe, so none is owed off-pod'.

repair.what: C2BehaviouralDriver.release_intermediates deletes each arm's intermediate step checkpoints AFTER the identity gate and AFTER the durable announcement, keeping the final. It never touches the final or anything outside the arm's workdir, and never raises — a cleanup failure must not destroy a verified, announced arm.
repair.ordering: after the gate, so a provenance finding keeps every intermediate it diverged through; after the announcement, so a verified arm is durable before anything is removed.
repair.regression: five tests: release-and-keep-final, the two delete guards, never-raises, the single-step case, and — added after a mutation survived — that `materialize_arm` actually CALLS the release, driven through the real method.
